feature.tts.description: Audio versions of pages, read by a neural voice on your server or on a GPU server.
feature.tts.name: Read aloud
js.tts.failed: Audio could not be generated. An administrator can retry it.
js.tts.failed_retry: Audio could not be generated. Try again in a moment.
js.tts.network_error: Could not reach the server. Try again.
js.tts.no_worker: Queued. The audio generator is not running right now, so this can take a while.
js.tts.remove_confirm: Remove the audio of this page?
js.tts.timeout: This is taking longer than usual. It carries on in the background, and this page checks now and then.
tts.admin.backend_problem: Audio cannot be generated right now: {problem} Queued pages wait until this is fixed.
tts.admin.backfill_done: {queued} pages queued ({skipped} already queued, {empty} without text).
tts.admin.backfill_hint: Queuing only adds pages to the list; the worker generates them one after another.
tts.admin.clear_confirm: Delete every audio file and empty the queue?
tts.admin.gpu_env: The GPU server is set in the environment (BW_TTS_REMOTE_GPU_URL and BW_TTS_REMOTE_GPU_AUTH_TOKEN); those values take precedence.
tts.admin.gpu_env_token_only: BW_TTS_REMOTE_GPU_AUTH_TOKEN is set in the environment but BW_TTS_REMOTE_GPU_URL is not. Set the server address in the environment as well: the address saved here is ignored, so that token is never sent to it.
tts.admin.gpu_hint: Send the text to a BananaWiki GPU speech server on your network (see contrib/tts-gpu-server). If it fails, this server's own voices are used.
tts.admin.gpu_managed: Audio generation servers are managed by your hosting provider.
tts.admin.gpu_test_ok: The GPU server answered. GPU available: {gpu}.
tts.admin.gpu_token_hint: The TTS_AUTH_TOKEN of the GPU server.
tts.admin.gpu_token_invalid: The token may only contain printable characters without spaces.
tts.admin.gpu_token_removed: The server address changed, so the saved token was removed. Enter the token of the new server.
tts.admin.gpu_token_set: A token is saved. Leave empty to keep it; it is removed when the server address changes.
tts.admin.gpu_url_hint: For example http://192.168.1.50:8787, without a path to /synthesize.
tts.admin.gpu_url_invalid: The GPU server address must be a plain http(s) address without a query string, fragment or credentials.
tts.admin.intro: Audio versions of pages. Requests are queued here and generated by the read-aloud worker.
tts.admin.languages_hint: The language of each page is detected among the languages ticked here.
tts.admin.mode_auto: Every time a page is created or edited
tts.admin.mode_auto_hint: Every page gets audio. This keeps the worker busy on large wikis.
tts.admin.mode_on_demand: When a reader asks for it
tts.admin.mode_on_demand_hint: Pages that already have audio get fresh audio after every edit.
tts.admin.no_worker: No read-aloud worker has run yet, so queued pages are not read. Start the read-aloud service (scripts/tts_worker.py) or set BW_TTS_INLINE_WORKER=1.
tts.admin.not_retried: This job cannot be retried now.
tts.admin.panel_hint: Readers can listen to pages and ask for audio that does not exist yet.
tts.admin.performance_hint: Faster settings produce audio sooner with a slightly flatter voice.
tts.admin.public: Visitors without an account can listen
tts.admin.public_hint: Only while the wiki is in public mode. Visitors can play existing audio but not generate it.
tts.admin.sys.ffmpeg_missing: Not installed: audio is stored as WAV and downloads at other playback speeds are unavailable
tts.admin.sys.langdetect_missing: Not installed: only English and Italian are recognised
tts.admin.sys.limits_value: At most {total} queued in total, {per_user} per person
tts.admin.title: Read aloud
tts.admin.worker_stopped: The read-aloud worker last checked in {when}, so queued pages are waiting. Check that the read-aloud service (scripts/tts_worker.py) is running.
tts.backend.remote-gpu: Remote GPU server (Piper on this server as fallback)
tts.blocked.disabled_by_host: Audio generation has been switched off by the hosting provider.
tts.blocked.login_required: Sign in to generate audio for this page.
tts.blocked.panel_disabled: Generating audio from the page is switched off.
tts.blocked.queue_full: The audio generator is busy. Try again when the current job has finished.
tts.blocked.user_queue_full: You already have audio waiting to be generated. Let it finish first.
tts.error.already_generated: Audio for this page already exists.
tts.error.already_in_progress: Audio for this page is already being generated.
tts.error.busy: The server is busy converting another file. Try again in a few seconds.
tts.error.empty_page: This page has no text to read aloud.
tts.error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
tts.error.unsupported_language: That language is not enabled for read aloud.
tts.panel.cut_short: This page is long: the audio reads its first part, up to where the highlighting stops.
tts.panel.hint: While you listen, click or tap a word in the page to read from there.
tts.panel.keys: While the player has focus, K plays or pauses, and J and L go to the previous and next paragraph.
tts.panel.title: Listen to this page
